notes: Improved: **smoother entrance animation for the Soft Editorial look.** Fade, slide, blur and (for letter-by-letter words) rise now each run on their own length and curve, modelled on measurements of two professional smooth-text animations: a quick soft-start fade, and a slide that glides to rest over about one second instead of jumping most of its distance in the first frame. The look itself (fonts, colours, layout, sizes, travel distance) is unchanged, and every word still appears exactly when it is spoken, not a frame earlier.
Improved: section 7 shows the new fade / slide / blur / scale lengths for looks that use this motion, and the preview uses the same maths as After Effects.

New: a reusable "silk" motion recipe for future caption looks. The other looks are unchanged. Checked in After Effects 25.2 (keyframes and rendered frames match the preview maths); not yet checked in other After Effects versions.
